notes: AMENDMENT 1 (msg 8290) applied: the exemption is recorded as absent_at_source, never as closed. The manifest entry carries absence_claim measured and closure_claim unknown, with candidate_day and prior_day. The gate listing key is account_lost_absent_at_source.

Gate integration: evaluate_publish_gate takes one optional argument absent_at_source_evidence (a callable, default None). It is called only when an account is lost; None changes nothing. The exemption runs inside the CLOSED-AT-SOURCE-A block, after the TERMINATED split and before account_lost is added.

Rule: absent_at_source_exempt is pure. It exempts a lost account only when it is in neither accounts_with_positions set of either table on either day, every partition is complete (candidate count at least 95 percent of the prior count, prior count above zero) and the prior partition is present. Any failure returns an empty exemption.

Manifest: absent_at_source_record writes an absent_at_source list into snapshot _manifest, the run manifest that run_firm returns. A run with no exempted account adds no key. The published .manifest.json is written by holdings/publication.py, outside this grant (channel row IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W419-S1).

BLOCKED part: the household listing of the exempted account in the served snapshot (AMENDMENT 1 part ii) needs account nodes built by holdings_49f.py, outside this grant (channel row IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W419-S2). Built: not_reported_display, which returns the words Not reported by the custodian since <date> with the earliest absent day. The named test for that part grades the words only and says so in its comment.

Not built here: the loader that reads evidence from each firm's source partitions, and any caller that passes the provider. No run_firm caller passes a provider, so production gate behaviour is unchanged.
